decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 1		NON-STD 1	The wider of the two front entrance doors shall have a badge/sign identifying it as being suitable for disabled and mobility impaired access. Reason: To ensure adequate accessibility to the disabled and to meet Council's 'Think Access' Supplementary Planning Guidance, and the requirements of Policy S.4.2.
Condition : 4 - 1		NON-STD 2	The sliding doors shall be closed by 21:00 every day the premises is open. Reason:  To mitigate potential noise effects on the surrounding area.

Condition : 5 - 1		NON-STD	Level or ramped access to the premises and decked area shall be provided.  Reason: To ensure adequate accessibility to the disabled and to meet Council's 'Think Access' Supplementary Planning Guidance, and the requirements of Policy S.4.2.
description: Installation of a new shop front incorporating internal alterations to shop and deck to front
